opening.argument: The presentation promotes an MEV bot that allegedly profits by sandwiching pending Uniswap transactions, stating that it "sandwiches the pending transaction" and profits from the slippage difference. It then directs viewers through compiling and deploying a contract, sending ETH through MetaMask, and funding the exact contract or bot address with at least 0.2 ETH. The narration ties operation to confirming MetaMask and sending gas money, while the supplied frames show an ETH send panel and deployed-contract Start, Stop, and Withdrawal controls. These instructions establish a solicitation to fund and activate the bot, although the available evidence does not establish actual profits, losses, contract ownership, recipient control, or that the code performs as described.

citations.quote: This essentially sandwiches the pending transaction and forces ours to be processed first, consequently profiting off of the slippage difference.
Deposit funds (at least 0.2 ETH to prevent negating slippage) to your exact contract/bot address
This will make MetaMask pop up, so we have to confirm this in order for the bot to start.
